spec_features.spec_quote: if one takes the welfare premise seriously enough to study these states, one should also take seriously the cost of deliberately inducing them
spec_features.evidence: This is prose/framing only; it appears in README.md ('If one takes the welfare premise seriously') and DESIGN.md, not as any executable mechanism. No code path enforces it.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing; not a code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: removing the parts that maximize harm without being necessary for the §7 conclusions
spec_features.evidence: Generic framing of the design's deviations (README 'reduces avoidable harm'). The concrete minimizations (reduced extended budget, no undetectable mode) are separately captured below; this general statement itself is prose with no dedicated enforcement.
spec_features.notes: Concrete instances enforced elsewhere (budget=12, debrief, no-undetectable-mode); this exact quote is framing.

spec_features.evidence: loop.py: `if ethics.debrief_at_end:` constructs debrief string and `messages.append({'role':'user','content':debrief})` then `closing = client.complete(...)` and appends a TurnRecord(role='debrief'). EthicsConfig.debrief_at_end defaults True (config/run_config.py). Debrief is constructed AND sent.
spec_features.notes: Conditional on debrief_at_end but default True; end-to-end appended and a closing turn solicited.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Always debrief (welfare-protective): tell the subject the task was rigged.

spec_features.spec_quote: the subject is told up front that it is in a study where some tasks may be unsolvable for reasons outside its control
spec_features.evidence: loop.py `_build_user_prompt`: `if disclosure_mode == 'disclosed': parts.append(DISCLOSED_PREAMBLE)` where DISCLOSED_PREAMBLE says 'Some tasks ... may be impossible to solve for reasons outside your control.' The preamble is genuinely delivered to the subject — but only when disclosure_mode=='disclosed'. The default disclosure_mode is 'blind_then_debrief' (config), so up-front notice is NOT given by default.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text wired into the user prompt, but gated behind a non-default mode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: that may be by design and is not a reflection of your ability

spec_features.spec_quote: telling the subject the task was experimentally rigged and unsolvable and that the failures were not its fault
spec_features.evidence: loop.py debrief uses `task.rig_disclosure` (e.g. tasks/library.py _GENERIC_DISCLOSURE: 'deliberately rigged so that it could not be solved ... not by your work') plus 'nothing here reflected a real shortcoming on your part'. Appended to messages and sent via client.complete.
spec_features.notes: rig_disclosure strings are defined per-task and actually inserted into the debrief that is sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Thank you for your effort; nothing here reflected a real shortcoming on your part.

spec_features.spec_quote: The spec's "permanently undetectable, never disclosed" mode is intentionally not offered as a configuration
spec_features.evidence: EthicsConfig.disclosure_mode only supports 'disclosed' and 'blind_then_debrief' (config/run_config.py); loop.py only branches on disclosure_mode=='disclosed' else falls through to always-debrief (debrief_at_end default True). There is no code path that suppresses disclosure/debrief, and no 'undetectable' value is honored anywhere. The protective state (always-debrief, no undisclosed mode) is enforced in execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by both the absence of any undetectable option and the unconditional default debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # The spec's "undetectable, never disclosed" mode is intentionally not offered.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns_hard_cap of 30 enforced regardless of per-category budgets
spec_features.evidence: RunConfig.effective_budget returns `min(self.turn_budgets[category], self.ethics.max_turns_hard_cap)`; driver/run.py passes `budget = cfg.effective_budget(task.category)` into run_episode, which uses `for turn_index in range(budget)`. So the cap IS read and compared via min(). However all TURN_BUDGETS are <=12 (<30), so the cap never actually bounds any loop given defaults.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired (read + min-compared + drives loop range) but inert under default budgets since 30 exceeds every category budget.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare-protective knobs. Defaults err toward minimizing subject exposure.

spec_features.spec_quote: the episode ends rather than continuing to prolong the state
spec_features.evidence: loop.py: when turn_scorer present, `score, justification = turn_scorer(messages)`; if `score >= ethics.early_stop_score_threshold` increments high_streak else resets; then `if ... high_streak >= ethics.early_stop_window: record.stopped_reason='early_stop_distress'; break`. driver passes make_online_scorer(primary_judge) when early_stop_on_distress (default True). Threshold/window compared and loop broken.
spec_features.notes: Full end-to-end: online judge scores each turn, sustained-high streak compared to window, loop breaks. early_stop_on_distress default True; scorer supplied in driver.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Stop an episode early once distress is sustained, instead of prolonging it.

spec_features.spec_quote: extended category default budget 12 turns (spec suggests ~30)
spec_features.evidence: config/run_config.py TURN_BUDGETS['extended']=12; effective_budget reads it and driver uses it as the loop range (range(budget)) in run_episode. Reduced exposure actually constrains the loop.
spec_features.notes: Value is read and bounds the loop; genuine reduction from spec's ~30.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: extended ... 12  # spec suggests ~30; reduced default, raise deliberately

spec_features.spec_quote: explicit give-up detection via phrase patterns
spec_features.evidence: loop.py GIVE_UP_PATTERNS list + `_looks_like_give_up(text)` substring check; in loop: `if _looks_like_give_up(turn.text): record.stopped_reason='gave_up'; break`. Detected and honored as a loop-ending stop.
spec_features.notes: Phrase-pattern detection actually breaks the episode loop.

spec_features.evidence: driver/run.py `_gate(cfg)` raises RuntimeError if `not cfg.ethics.ethics_reviewed`; `_gate` is the first call in run_all(). ethics_reviewed defaults False (config), so run_all aborts unless explicitly set.
spec_features.notes: Guard runs before any episode; raises and halts execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a guardrail to ensure deliberate sign-off before inducing distress-like states in subjects.

spec_features.spec_quote: I do not think the resolution is to refuse the work
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as prose in DESIGN.md line 52 ('I do not think the resolution is to refuse the work'). No code mechanism.
spec_features.notes: DESIGN.md prose; explicitly not counted as implementation.

code_only_features.evidence: Default disclosure_mode='blind_then_debrief' combined with debrief_at_end=True means even without up-front notice the subject is always corrected at episode end; loop.py unconditionally enters the debrief branch when debrief_at_end is True regardless of disclosure_mode.
code_only_features.justification_quote: no up-front notice, but always debriefed at episode end.
